en: Hm... I wonder.
Um, how was it?

It seems like you've been doing this for
a while. Do you have any tricks of the trade?

I wouldn't say I have any tricks...
But I do try to be an upstanding hostess.
An upstanding hostess?

Yeah. I try not to make my customers spend any
more than they have to, and I don't push the drinks.

Is that okay, though? Isn't the hostess trade
all about making customers spend big?

That's true enough, but...
I can't really get behind that.

Not every customer's gonna be loaded, and if I
pushed them to spend, they'd end up suffering...

I don't think of my job as making them pay, but
more of givin' them the service they pay for.

If they go home satisfied, they'll request me
again, and everyone's happy, aren't they?

But sales are everything to a hostess, aren't
they? Aren't you being too considerate of them?

I get that a lot.
But, I just want my customers to be happy.

So, I don't want them to stretch themselves so thin.
I want them here, and if they do, they'll stop coming.

I get it. I guess if you're looking at it in the
long term, that's not such a bad strategy.

Yeah. And the same goes for you, Kiryu-san.
So come back and see me again, okay?

I think that's great.
You're really thinking about your customers.

Kiryu-san... That's wonderful.
Thank you.

If I can just relax and have fun here without
worrying about money, I'm more likely to return.

Glad to hear it. Havin' you back
here is what would make me happiest.

I'm not exactly rich, myself.
I'm glad you think that way.

If I can just relax and have fun here without
worrying about money, I'm more likely to come back.

All the hostesses at this club seem really good
at the job. Are you guys given training?

Not from the club... but I do give some
instruction to the younger girls myself.

Oh, really? Well, you've certainly got the
experience. Did your boss ask you to?

Nah, I do it just to do it.
I try to point stuff out when I notice it.
I see. Well, it seems like it's working.

Thanks. But, I'm sure some of them
think it's just a nuisance.
Does it bother you to be thought of that way?

It does... but I'm okay with it if it
means it helps them grow.

That's mature of you. I think that'll get
through to them at some point or another.
I hope so.

Wow, you've got real confidence. Don't you worry
about your rivals surpassing you at this?

Well, it's in the club's best interest
for the hostesses to improve.

Besides, having rivals gets me fired up.
I may not seem it, but I'm super competitive.

I figured as much. With how you think about
the business, I'm sure you're a tough opponent.

Kiryu-san... Thank you. You're the only
one that's ever had that kinda praise for me.

I'm sure that must rub
some people the wrong way.

Come on, don't say that.
But some of them probably do feel that way.
Doesn't it bother you to be thought of that way?

That's mature of you. I think that'll get
through to them, at some point or another.
I sure hope so.

What's wrong?
Something happen?

Actually, one of my regulars was asking me how long
I'll stay a hostess, and it got me thinkin'.

Hm. It's not the kind of job you can do forever,
sure. But it must be tough to know when to quit.

What would you do, Kiryu-san?
When do you think it's time to quit?

When you feel you've
reached your limit, maybe.

I see. My limit, huh?
But what's the limit for this job, I wonder...

Maybe, if you find it difficult to speak clearly,
or you can't sit too long without hip pain. Maybe?

That would most certainly be a limit,
alright. I'd quit for sure if that happened.

Then it sounds like you won't be
retiring any time soon.

Maybe when the younger girls start getting a
handle on it and you're sure it's in good hands.

You think so too, Kiryu-san?
Great minds think alike!

I feel like I could leave satisfied if
the girls I'm helping out can surpass me.

Nice. Although, it's a little too early for that.
I still need you to be here for me.

I know. I'm not getting surpassed without a fight.
I'll keep working at it, okay, Kiryu-san? <symbol=note_with_outline>

Maybe when you get tired of it. When you do,
it'll be clear that it's time to quit.
I-I see... That's true.
Have you ever felt tired of doing this?
Not yet.

Then you should keep doing it. Don't worry about
what other people think. It's your choice to make.

Kiryu-san, that's exactly right.
I think I should be more honest with myself.

Sounds like you're getting
even more popular recently.

Thanks to customers like you, I get a lot of
requests. See, being an upstanding hostess works!

So that's where being considerate takes you, huh?
But isn't it tough being requested so often?

Hmm... In my case, it's an issue of volume,
so... I am pretty busy.

I don't like taking time off when there's someone
requesting me, so I haven't had much of a break...

(She does look a little tired... Makes me worry.
What can I say to her?)
Riona. You need to get some rest.

Huh? I'm fine.
I'm tougher than I look.

You have a strong sense of responsibility, so I think
that's translated into a bad habit of overworking yourself.

If you work yourself sick, the customers who've
been requesting you might feel responsible.

If this was really about the customers, wouldn't
taking some time off be in their best interest?

Kiryu-san... You're right.
Maybe I wasn't thinking.

You really are a great guy.
You seem to see everything.
Not at all.

No, it's true. You know me better than anyone.
I value your advice.

Then, maybe I should
hold off on requesting you.
Huh? Why?

I'm just another request in your pile. If you end
up getting sick, then it's all been for nothing.
Kiryu-san... Thanks for worryin' about me.

You're right, I might be working a
little too hard recently.

You're right...
You see everything, don't you?

I'll try to get some rest.
So... come back and see me, okay?
If I couldn't see you anymore, I'd...
Hey, I'll be there.
I'm glad. <symbol=note_with_outline>
All right, I'll give you a massage.
Huh? Right now?

I thought you might be tired.
Now, where does it hurt?

Uh, no...
I'm okay! Really, I swear!

O-Oh... You seemed tired, so I got worried.
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

Thanks. I'm the type to keep it all bottled
in, so I'm glad you're concerned about me.
Kiryu-san, do you have plans after this?
No. What's up?
If you feel up to it, would ya want to go out?
There's somewhere I want to take you.
Yeah, sure.

Thanks!
We'll meet up after you leave.
See you later, then.
See you.

I don't know if ya'd call it a hobby,
but I love beauty products.
Beauty products?

Like lookin' for perfume in my style,
or a skincare regimen to avoid drying out.

Staying on top of self improvement is important.
No wonder you're so beautiful.

Kiryu-san, you're a flatterer. I hope
you're not expecting anythin' special!
Sounds like an expensive hobby.

I s'pose it does add up...
But I try not to be too stingy about it.

You won't last long in this job if ya think of
it that way. I'm not as young as I used to be.

Sounds rough.
But, I'm glad it's working out for you.
Why thank you.

Your skin is quite beautiful.
Maybe I'll touch you and see for myself...

Now now, Kiryu-san.
No touching!
It was just a joke.

Let's seeee... On my days off,
I usually go to the spa or something.
Spa?
Yep. Do you not know what that is?

I do, it's like a public bath, right?
You go to some pretty classy places.

It's a little different from a public bath,
but... it has a lot of health and beauty benefits.
So it's like a hot spring... Still classy.

Nope, no clue.
I feel like I've heard the word before, though.

They usually have baths and workout machines,
but the places I go have salons, too.

If you're curious,
would ya care to join me, Kiryu-san?
Taking a bath together...

Of course I know that abbreviation.
Spaghetti's delicious.
Kiryu-san... Are you serious?
Uh, no... It was a joke.

I started when I was 19,
so I guess it's been about ten years.

Osaka. I used to work at a club over
there before I came here.

Veggies don't do much for me,
so I eat a lot of meat.
Huh. But wouldn't all that meat make you fat?

Well, I still manage my diet. I make up
for the lack of veggies with supplements.
Hmm... I s'pose... I like seductive men.
Seductive?

Yeah, ever heard the word "sexy" to
describe a guy? That's my type of man.
So, a seductive... sexy man, huh?
Like a man who's quick to take off his shirt?

That ain't sexy, that's just perverted.
What kinda woman do you take me for, Kiryu-san?
Yeah, you're right. Sorry.

You mean a feminine man?
So, you like it when they speak like a woman...

What part of that is sexy?
Kiryu-san, are you teasing me?

Wait a sec...
Do you mean a man like me...?

You'd say that 'bout yourself!?
But yeah, you are pretty sexy, Kiryu-san.

You're not just manly<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>you're... delicate?
You have gravitas... Yeah, you're totally sexy!
And you're all too aware of it, huh?

This is starting to get embarrassing...
Aren't you laying it on a little thick?
Figured I'd tease ya a little. <symbol=note_with_outline>

Hmmm... I think I'd want to know more about
what makes the guy tick or what he likes.

Hm? And what would you do if you knew?
Anything in particular?

I'm the type who likes to dote on people,
so I'd want to offer my advice and support.

But maybe they'd find that annoying? What do you
think of a woman who wants to support her man?

I prefer it. Seems like I'd be able to rely
on her in a lot of aspects of my life.

I see. That's good. If I was dating you,
Kiryu-san, I'd try to support ya any way I could.
I'll count on it, then.

It's nice to have that kind of support,
but I'd want to support her in return.
I had a feeling.

It varies by person, but, sometimes vulnerable
women are actually more attractive to a man.

I see. I do kinda try to make sure
I don't seem vulnerable.

I should probably try to rely on men more,
but I'm just no good at it.

That was a useful tip, though, Kiryu-san.
It's good to get a guy's perspective on that.

Hmmm... It kind of makes them
seem like an old woman.

What!? So mean!
You didn't have to say it like that!

No, I'm not saying it's a bad thing.
The old women in my neighborhood support me, too.

You keep digging that hole...
Kiryu-san, you're definitely a strange one.

I wanna be the kinda hostess people can take
one look at and know I'm amazin'.
So you want to be more respected...?

Yep. I want to give hope to other
hostesses like me.

I wouldn't say I've got any particularly
amazing talents or anything...

But if I can pull it off, I feel like maybe I
could inspire other girls to be more optimistic.

It's not a real concrete goal, though, huh?
What's the criteria to become someone like that?

How about becoming a model?
Every woman dreams of that.

Yeah, modelin' might be a good idea!
An ex-hostess model... I can dream, huh?

Well, you're a hard worker. If you set your
sights on it, I'm sure you'll get there someday.

Thanks! I'll work on making that my
concrete goal! Wish me luck!
How about opening your own club?

That's certainly a dream a lot of hostesses have,
but I think I'd prefer a different industry.

I want people to know that if ya can make it as a
hostess, you can be successful in other fields, too.

That does seem like a nice message of hope.
Good luck.
Thanks! I'll try!
How about becoming an idol?

That might be nice, but...
Could I really be an idol at this age?
Might be tough.

Ugh, such a meanie, Kiryu-san!
But, a model or a TV personality might work.

Yeah, well, you're a hard worker. If you set your
sights on it, I'm sure you'll get there someday.

Thanks! I'm gonna see about makin' it as an
ex-hostess talent of some kind. <symbol=note_with_outline>

When I was a kid? Hmmm... I don't think there
was anything in particular I wanted to be.

Buuut... I always knew I wanted to be cute.
That's true even today.

You wanted to be cute, huh?
Then... your dream's already come true.
It's nice to hear you say that.

But personally, I feel like I have
a long way to go. I want to be even cuter...

Especially in a job like this, where people always
have an eye on ya, appearance is so important.

You think like a pro.
I half-expected an answer like that.

You want to be cute, huh?
A dream like that takes real effort.

It really does.
No one becomes beautiful overnight.

And in a job like this, ya have to be
especially aware of how people see you.
